name: Physics
notes: An average of at least 2.0 is required in the introductory physics sequences and in all introductory mathematics courses.
The department page writes PHY/MTH; the registrar catalog uses PHYS/MATH, the form used here.
The department also offers an Astronomy minor, not yet encoded.
PHYS 244W is named on the page but was not scheduled in the harvested terms; it appears as a flagged stub.
